    "Model forecasts are consistently below current prices, showing significant lag that narrows as forecasts extend further into the future",
    "Sentiment turning positive (1.00) correlates with model undershooting current prices, while negative sentiment (0.00) aligns better but still shows lag",
    "Price mean reversion is evident in both model forecasts and true outcomes, with the gap between them narrowing from 2-3 dollars today to ~1 dollar at the 30-day horizon",
    "Model shows excessive volatility compared to true outcomes, particularly in the first 10-day forecast window where daily changes exceed 1-2 dollars while reality shows much flatter correction curves",
    "When prices are in a clear downtrend, model forecasts remain too high by 1-3 dollars, reflecting delayed recognition of the downward momentum",
    "Sentiment strength (1.00) provides no correction to this undershooting issue, suggesting the model underweights sentiment signals in early forecast horizons",
    "The gap between model forecasts and true outcomes follows a clear convex pattern: widest at 0-5 days (approx. 1.5-2.00d), gradually compressing to ~0.5-1.00d by day 30"
] }
